Chapter 993: Chapter 9 Refining the Jade Gourd (Subscribe Please)_2

However, after fully understanding all runes, Lin Yuan is essentially finding a fixed ‘template’. As long as he alters according to the rune structures, no accidents will occur.

Of course, receiving guidance would certainly be faster.

“No problem.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He indeed had no particular wariness towards the red-clothed girl toddler.

If the creator of the Jade Gourd truly bore any killing intent towards him, there was no need for such complications; a mere thought could suppress Lin Yuan.

Even a universe birthed from the Chaos Void cannot withstand it.

Yet now, even beings of the time-life level in the Thirteenth Layer could not completely annihilate him.

Because he has an avatar in the Yuan world, and upon entering the Twelfth Layer, more functionalities of the Myriad Realms Gate were unearthed. Descending to the Yuan world consumed nearly half of Lin Yuan’s True Spirit Consciousness, which is equivalent to another great avatar.

Even if the original body in Chaos Void perishes, it would not affect the avatar in the Yuan world.

With the means of the Thirteenth Layer time-life level, one could effortlessly annihilate all of Lin Yuan’s original body and Primordial Spirit Avatars in this Chaos Void.

But in the Yuan world?

The Yuan world and Chaos Void exist in different dimensions, and even for beings of the Thirteenth Layer time-life level, it is challenging to cross over. Beings at this level are only in the exploratory stage concerning other dimensional spaces.

Lin Yuan can descend easily to the Yuan world by leveraging the power of the Myriad Realms Gate.

Without the Myriad Realms Gate, invading other dimensions would face unimaginable resistance, and even the Thirteenth Layer time-life entities would be helpless against it.

Rustle…

Lin Yuan barely managed to control the Jade Gourd and let the red-clothed girl toddler enter his internal universe.

The moment the red-clothed girl toddler left the Jade Gourd and sensed the external atmosphere, a look of relief appeared on her face; she didn’t know how long it had been since she last felt the true fluctuations emitted by the Chaos Void.

To the red-clothed girl toddler, these fluctuations were an unparalleled indulgence.

“Hmm?”

“The life level is only at the Path Splitting Realm?”

Suddenly, the red-clothed girl toddler sensed Lin Yuan’s life aura, and as the Spirit of the Jade Gourd, her perception even exceeded some Chaos Great Saints.

“Path Splitting Realm?”

The red-clothed girl toddler fell into silence again.

The Path Splitting Realm and he figured out all the runes? And it only took him one year?

Hum!

The next moment, the red-clothed girl toddler entered Lin Yuan’s internal universe.

“Nearly eight million light-years?” The red-clothed girl toddler was slightly surprised. However, thinking about the time Lin Yuan took to comprehend all the runes, she quickly became calm again.

An internal universe of the Path Splitting Realm reaching eight million light-years is incredibly rare. Even with the foundation laid by the Jade Gourd’s seven types of Divine Liquids, a substantial base is needed.

But the Chaos Void is vast and endless, many extraordinary life forms with time bloodlines naturally harbored immensely vast internal universes at birth. It’s not impossible for a Path Splitting Realm to have an internal universe close to eight million light-years.

Compared to the size of the internal universe, what shocked the red-clothed girl toddler the most was Lin Yuan’s comprehension ability. Comprehending all runes in one year was something not even those extraordinary lives with rich time bloodlines could achieve.

“Let me take a look.”

The red-clothed girl toddler glanced around and after closing her eyes and feeling around for a bit, she pointed at a location and said, “Start from there.”

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He immediately began to control that area, rebuilding it using the template of the first rune internal universe and started to piece it together.

“Hmm?”

A faint tremor spread throughout the internal universe, and Lin Yuan slightly furrowed his brows, stopping his actions.

“How is it?”

“Do you feel like your internal universe is about to collapse?”

The red-clothed girl toddler said with a smile.

“Yes.” Lin Yuan nodded.

“That’s normal.”

“Altering the universe’s structure impacts the entire universe.”

The red-clothed girl toddler said with a smile, “Any changes to the universe’s structure will cause a similar sensation.”

“However, others altering the universe’s structure run the risk of their internal universes’ complete collapse, but you needn’t worry about that.”

The red-clothed girl toddler said.

After fully understanding all runes, altering the universe’s structure for Lin Yuan is as simple as taking an open-book exam.

Lin Yuan quietly listened by her side.

“I continue.”

Lin Yuan once again became immersed in the task of altering the structure of the universe within his body.

[Your innate understanding defies the natural order, attempting to change the fundamental structure of the universe, enhancing your comprehension of the universe’s essence, and accelerating the modification of the universe’s fundamental structure…]

At first, Lin Yuan’s pace of altering the universe was quite slow; after all, he had to be extremely careful, as even with the standard answers in hand, one must proceed with caution.

But as the modifications deepened, Lin Yuan quickly became ‘proficient’, and the speed of change also soared.

“This monster…”

The little girl in red watched from the side.

Initially, she could offer some suggestions, such as guiding Lin Yuan where and in which direction to alter, but gradually, the little girl in red found she was unable to give any more advice.

Even the means Lin Yuan used to change the fundamental structure of the universe were more exquisite than what she knew.

Each universe is different, and the little girl in red mastered only the general direction of the fundamental changes in the universe’s structure. She naturally couldn’t compare to Lin Yuan in understanding this particular inner universe.

…

The Source World, Qingfen Domain, Yu Family.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his breath deeply concealed.

“Shifting to Martial Tao is going quite smoothly.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly. The original Yu Yan was equivalent to the Eighth or Ninth Layer of the Chaos Void, with an immense amount of Yuan energy contained within his body.

As Lin Yuan re-cultivated Martial Tao, he naturally didn’t waste this Yuan energy, transforming it all into nourishment for Martial Tao refinement.

“Fierce Sun Ancient Country…”

Lin Yuan once again looked up at the eternal sun that spanned the sky, and then a practice method emerged in his mind.

“Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method.”

Through a specific method, condensing a Seed of the Fierce Sun within the body.

The Seed of the Fierce Sun had many uses, reinforcing the physical body, guarding the soul and the spirit, etc.

Every creature in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, from birth, was bestowed with this “Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method” to forge their foundation.

“This ‘Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method’ is said to come from the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, and spreading it to every creature within the ancient country was also the will of that Ancestor.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The “Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method” progresses from easy to difficult. It is easy to condense a single Seed of the Fierce Sun, but to condense ten Seeds is extremely difficult. To condense a hundred Seeds? That is something only a Twelfth Layer Self-Dao Realm powerhouse can accomplish.

In this world, the Self-Dao Realm is referred to as the Path Splitting Realm, and the general idea is much the same—to carve out one’s own path.

“I can start by practicing it a bit to see if I can integrate it with Martial Tao.”

Lin Yuan contemplated to himself.

As for the true main body in the Chaos Void? He is still waiting for the results of his cultivation.

The “Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method” originates from the Ancestor of Fierce Sun. It’s unclear if there are hidden dangers, but cultivating with this body, the worst outcome is just giving up this descent.

It’s completely within Lin Yuan’s tolerance.

It will not affect the true main body in the Chaos Void.

“The original body spent hundreds of years to condense only nine Seeds of the Fierce Sun.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself; a member of the Dongyang Clan, Dongyang Meng, also managed to condense nine Seeds of the Fierce Sun, which was why she and the original were honored as the last candidates likely to enter the service of Lord Qingfen.

“Unfortunately, those nine Seeds of the Fierce Sun were destroyed due to the Dongyang Family’s assassination attempt, three of which shattered, and then when I shifted to Martial Tao, the remaining six also disintegrated.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The “Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method” is neither a legacy nor a Dao but rather like a method that assists in cultivation, increasing certain foundational qualities by condensing Seeds of the Fierce Sun within the body.

The more Seeds of the Fierce Sun one has, the greater the corresponding benefits one receives.

As for what those benefits are, the original body was not clear, only feeling that with each additional Seed of the Fierce Sun condensed, the speed of his cultivation increased slightly.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged, his Martial Tao strength was recovering quickly, and without needing much effort, he decided it was worthwhile to give the “Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method” a try.

Rustle.

Between heaven and earth.

Threads of scorching breath flowed into Lin Yuan’s body, beginning to condense slowly.

[Your innate understanding defies the natural order, cultivating the “Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method” and forming the first Seed of the Fierce Sun]

…

[Your innate understanding defies the natural order, cultivating the “Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method” and forming the third Seed of the Fierce Sun]

…

[Your innate understanding defies the natural order, cultivating the “Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method” and forming the fifth Seed of the Fierce Sun]
